name: iphone17pro_default
description: Current physical push tool (Fusion: iPhone17_DataTool) on the reBot B601-RS: the robot flange (joint-6 rotor) carries the gripper connector (part A screwed to the rotor, part B = a cup over A held by 3 radial screws), and the pusher is printed in one piece with part B. Without fillets/crush ribs, hemispherical tip, TCP at the golden-section line. Units: mm, deg.

adapter.desc: Flange adapter between the robot flange and the pusher (here the reBot gripper connector, parts A and B). Off = the pusher base sits directly on the robot flange; set adapter_h = 0 and the hole_* / mount_screws parameters to the robot's own pattern (see configs/rebot_rs_flange.json).
adapter.desc_zh: 机械臂法兰和推杆之间的法兰转接件（这里是 reBot 夹爪连接件 A + B）。关掉 = 推杆底座直接装在机械臂法兰上；同时要把 adapter_h 设为 0，并把 hole_* / mount_screws 改成机械臂自己的孔位（见 configs/rebot_rs_flange.json）。

phone.desc: Phone camera with its holder and connector. Off = the rod alone: holder, beam and spine are left out and the camera solve is skipped.
phone.desc_zh: 手机相机及其支架和连接件。关掉 = 只要推杆：去掉支架、横梁和支撑条，并跳过相机看向 TCP 的求解。

telephoto.desc: Telephoto camera frames (C_tele, C_tele_cv) and its MJCF camera. Off for a phone without a telephoto (e.g. iPhone 17). Needs the option phone.
telephoto.desc_zh: 长焦相机的坐标系（C_tele、C_tele_cv）和它在 MJCF 里的相机。没有长焦的手机（例如 iPhone 17）关掉。依赖 phone 选项。

lidar.desc: LiDAR scanner frame (S_lidar). Off for a phone without LiDAR, or when its position is not known. Needs the option phone.
lidar.desc_zh: LiDAR 扫描仪的坐标系（S_lidar）。没有 LiDAR 的手机，或位置未知时关掉。依赖 phone 选项。

g1_adapter.desc: Unitree G1 wrist adapter: a plug that the G1 wrist clamp ring holds, with a flat face carrying the reBot hole pattern (4 x M3 heat-set inserts, turned 90 deg). On = the adapter is drawn on F_robot = the G1 wrist end interface; use it with adapter off, adapter_h = 16 and the hole pattern of the adapter (the editor sets these when the G1 wrist adapter is selected).
g1_adapter.desc_zh: Unitree G1 腕部转接件：G1 手腕的夹环夹住它的插头，另一面是 reBot 孔位（4 个 M3 热熔螺母，转过 90°）。打开 = 在 F_robot（即 G1 手腕末端接口）上画出转接件；同时要关掉 adapter，adapter_h 设为 16，孔位用这个转接件的（编辑器选“G1 腕部转接件”时会自动设好）。

C_main.desc: iPhone 17 Pro main camera, 24 mm equivalent, 4:3, landscape. min_focus_mm unknown: fill in to enable the check.

C_ultrawide.desc: iPhone 17 Pro Ultra Wide, 13 mm equivalent, 4:3 landscape. fovy 88.4 = measured short-side FOV at 1920x1440 with focus at infinity (intrinsics yaml 2026-11-08, fx 740.38); about 18 % focus breathing.

C_tele.desc: iPhone 17 Pro 4x Telephoto, 100 mm equivalent, 4:3 landscape (nominal fovy from the equivalent focal length, not measured).

F_robot.desc: Robot flange frame as the robot defines it: origin on the flange face, +Z out of the flange. reBot B601-RS: the link6 frame of the Seeed URDF (joint-6 rotor face).

F_adapter.desc: Flange adapter frame = F_robot: the gripper connector sits on the rotor as in the official assembly (rotor screws at +-30 deg from +-X, radial screws at 60/180/300 deg).

F_g1_adapter.desc: G1 wrist adapter frame = F_robot = the G1 wrist end interface (URDF: wrist_yaw_link + 41.5 mm along X): +Z out of the wrist, +X along the wrist yaw axis. The plug is in -Z, the flange face at z = 16.

F_mount.desc: Face the pusher base sits on (the adapter's tool face, or the robot flange without an adapter). +Z from robot to tool, +X toward the rod tilt; turned by mount_rot about the flange axis.

F_tool.desc: Tool-side face of the pusher base plate.

R_rod.desc: Rod axis at the adapter face; +Z along the rod toward the tip.

T_tip.desc: Centre of the rod end face.

T_tcp.desc: Contact reference point = apex of the hemispherical tip. +Z = rod direction.

P_phone.desc: Phone frame = iMuninn `device`: centre of the display active area on the outer surface of the front glass, +X to the right edge, +Y to the top (camera end), +Z out of the screen (Core Motion axes).

C_main.desc: Main camera, MuJoCo convention: looks along -Z, +X image right, +Y image up. Landscape, phone top to image LEFT, so the rod enters from the bottom of the image.

C_cv.desc: Same camera, OpenCV convention (+Z forward, +Y image down).

C_ultrawide.desc: Ultra Wide camera (Rear Camera 1, 125 deg keepout cone), centre of the lens window on the outer cover glass. Position (uw_x, uw_y) from iMuninn's phone data (Apple iPhone 17 Pro dimensional drawing 2025-09-09). Axis parallel to C_main, same landscape convention.

C_ultrawide_cv.desc: C_ultrawide in OpenCV convention (+Z forward, +Y image down).

C_tele.desc: Telephoto camera (Rear Camera 3, 34 deg keepout cone), centre of the lens window on the outer cover glass. Position (tele_x, tele_y) from iMuninn's phone data. Axis parallel to C_main.

C_tele_cv.desc: C_tele in OpenCV convention (+Z forward, +Y image down).

S_lidar.desc: LiDAR scanner (REAR SENSOR, d6.65, 84 deg keepout cone; back view (58.03, -34.16)). Position from iMuninn's phone data; height assumed equal to the lens glass (not dimensioned). Axes as C_main.

L_flash.desc: True Tone flash (d6.80; back view (58.03, -13.82)). Position from iMuninn's phone data; height assumed equal to the lens glass (not dimensioned). Axes as C_main.

C_front.desc: Front (selfie) camera, ESTIMATED position (iMuninn: centre of the right end cap of the front-camera keep-out on Apple's drawing; the drawing does not mark the lens). MuJoCo convention, looks along +Z_P (out of the screen). Axes from iMuninn (device_rot_front_optical = [[0,1,0],[-1,0,0],[0,0,1]] for C_front_cv; native image rotation 90 deg measured on iPhone 17 Pro).

C_front_cv.desc: C_front in OpenCV convention (+Z forward, +Y image down).

S_mount.desc: MagSafe centre on the support plate surface; +Z toward the phone. The phone locks onto the holder by MagSafe, so this is the phone's MagSafe circle centre (magsafe_x, magsafe_y in P_phone) moved back by the case gap.

J_foot.desc: Where the spine (running down the support plane from S_mount) reaches the beam's vertical mid-plane x = beam_x; axes parallel to F_tool.

J_bend.desc: Mitre between the beam (rising along +Z) and the support strip (rising along +X of S_mount): origin on both centre lines, +Z normal to the mitre plane.

parts.name: tool_body

union.name: base
union.desc: Pusher base plate on the mount face (F_mount).

union.name: rod
union.desc: Round rod (diameter rod_D) along R_rod +Z, embedded rod_embed into the adapter.

union.name: tip
union.desc: Hemisphere on the rod end face; its apex is T_tcp.

difference.name: beam
difference.desc: Straight beam along -Y on the flange centre line, standing on the adapter face; its top meets the spine.

difference.name: spine
difference.desc: Strip in the support plane from the holder's lower edge (overlapping it by spine_overlap so the print fuses) down to the beam.

union.name: spine_back
union.desc: Spine continued up the back of the holder plate in the rib layer (z from -plate_t to holder_back_z), ending in a V along the centre lines of the two lower arms of the holder's X ribs (crossing at spine_back_to, arms at spine_back_ang to the spine axis). The load then goes into the ribs instead of through the thin plate at the joint.

difference.name: relief_centre
difference.desc: Clearance for a feature at the centre of the robot flange.

union.name: cup
union.desc: Adapter part B printed in one piece with the pusher (the current physical tool).

union.name: cup_weld
union.desc: Overlap between the cup and the base plate, so the two fuse into one solid.

parts.desc: The printed pusher: base plate, rod, tip, beam and spine; with mount_screws = 0 also the cup of adapter part B.

parts.name: holder
parts.desc: Slide-lock MagSafe connector, imported unchanged from Fusion (ip17case_connector).

parts.name: phone
parts.desc: Phone shape, as in iMuninn's glb: body outline with rounded corners (corner_r, estimated) and one cylinder per rear lens window (ring_D) up to the camera glass (bump_h); the telephoto lens goes with the telephoto option. Sized by the phone parameters; the editor's camera group sets them per phone. Frames are unaffected. Density set so the iPhone 17 Pro shape weighs 206 g (Apple).

parts.name: adapter_a
parts.desc: reBot gripper connector part A (official 2-M6-ROTOR.step, CNC aluminium): screwed onto the joint-6 rotor with 4 x M3 (PCD 27, at +-30 deg from +-X), 3 radial M3 threads for part B. Simplified to primitives; bought with the arm, not printed.

parts.name: adapter_b
parts.desc: reBot gripper connector part B (official 2-M7-STATOR.step) as a separate part: 4 x M3 from the robot side (PCD 38, 45 deg) into the pusher base. With mount_screws = 0 it is the cup printed with the pusher instead.

parts.name: g1_wrist_adapter
parts.desc: Unitree G1 wrist adapter (variant rot90: reBot hole pattern with its long side along Y, 4 x M4 on the axes at PCD 50), drawn from its mesh.

checks.msg: 手机太低，支撑条会穿到法兰面以下：调大 phone_flange_angle 或 distance，或缩短 rod_L 时一起调
checks.msg_en: Phone too low: the spine would pass below the flange face. Increase phone_flange_angle or distance (adjust them together when shortening rod_L).

interference.msg: 推杆本体穿过了手机：减小 rod_tilt，或调大 phone_flange_angle / distance
interference.msg_en: The pusher body passes through the phone: reduce rod_tilt, or increase phone_flange_angle / distance

interference.msg: 手机和卡扣重叠：调大 back_to_mount（手机壳厚度 + 间隙）
interference.msg_en: The phone overlaps its holder: increase back_to_mount (case thickness + clearance)

interference.msg: 杆穿过了手机卡扣：减小 rod_tilt，或调大 phone_flange_angle / distance
interference.msg_en: The rod passes through the phone holder: reduce rod_tilt, or increase phone_flange_angle / distance

interference.desc: Line from the main camera to the ball centre, stopping 1 mm outside the ball. The rod itself is left out: the camera always sees the rod from the side.
interference.msg: 相机看向杆尖的视线被挡住了
interference.msg_en: Something blocks the camera's line of sight to the tip

interference.msg: 推杆和法兰转接件重叠
interference.msg_en: The pusher overlaps the flange adapter

interference.desc: Socket heads seated in the counterbores must not touch the printed body.
interference.msg: 法兰螺钉头和推杆本体干涉：加大 cbore_d / cbore_depth，或改 mount_rot
interference.msg_en: A flange screw head hits the pusher body: enlarge cbore_d / cbore_depth, or change mount_rot

interference.desc: key_L of free height (diameter key_d) above every screw head: the least an L-shaped hex key needs.
interference.msg: 法兰螺钉上方被推杆挡住，拧不了：改 mount_rot，或挪开横梁 / 杆根
interference.msg_en: A flange screw is covered by the pusher and cannot be reached: change mount_rot, or move the beam / rod root

interference.desc: A straight driver (driver_L long) from above; the phone is taken off for mounting, so it is not an obstacle.
interference.msg: 有法兰螺钉上方不能用直螺丝刀（标出的位置被挡），要用短的 L 型内六角扳手
interference.msg_en: Some flange screws cannot take a straight driver (blocked at the marked spot); use a short L-shaped hex key

references.name: RobotTool (Fusion, real part)
references.desc: Exported from iPhone17_DataTool in Fusion world coordinates; Fusion +X = flange axis, so p_mount = (-z, y, x).

param_notes.mount_rot: Angle of the pusher about the flange axis: F_mount +X (the rod tilt direction) measured from F_robot +X. The base holes stay on the robot/adapter pattern, so any angle can be printed.
param_notes.adapter_h: Height of the adapter: from the robot flange face (F_robot) to the face the pusher base sits on (F_mount). 0 without an adapter.
param_notes.mount_screws: How the pusher base is fixed: 0 = printed in one piece with adapter part B (no screws), 1 = screws from the adapter side into blind holes, 2 = screws from the tool side through counterbored holes.
param_notes.hole_rot: Angle of the first hole in F_robot; the others are at +hole_ang2, +180, +180+hole_ang2 (hole_ang2 = 90 for a square pattern).
param_notes.back_to_mount: Phone back to support plate = case back thickness. 3.25 = measured on an iPhone 17 Pro case (3.2-3.3 mm, 2026-11-16); was 3.0.
param_notes.spine_back: 1 = continue the spine up the back of the holder, in the rib layer, until it meets the X ribs (stops the thin plate at the joint from bending and cracking); 0 = old butt joint.
param_notes.spine_back_to: S_mount x of the V tip of the back reinforcement = crossing point of the holder's X ribs (2.25 for SlideLock_Connector_local.stl).
param_notes.spine_back_ang: Angle between each lower arm of the holder's X ribs and the spine axis (deg); the reinforcement ends in a V cut along the two arm centre lines (42.6 for SlideLock_Connector_local.stl).
param_notes.spine_back_w: Width of the back reinforcement (defaults to the spine width).
param_notes.holder_back_z: S_mount z of the back face of the holder plate (where the ribs start); the reinforcement fills from -plate_t up to here (+ spine_overlap). -4 for SlideLock_Connector_local.stl.
param_notes.uw_x: Ultra Wide lens window centre in P_phone (uw_x, uw_y; mm). The iPhone 17 Pro values are from Apple's dimensional drawing (Rear Camera 1); the editor's camera group sets them per phone from the iMuninn phone data.
param_notes.tele_x: Telephoto lens window centre in P_phone (tele_x, tele_y; mm); see uw_x.
param_notes.feq_tele: Telephoto equivalent focal length (mm); sets the nominal fovy of C_tele.
param_notes.front_x: Front camera in P_phone (front_x, front_y; mm). Estimated: Apple does not dimension the front camera itself.
param_notes.lidar_x: LiDAR scanner centre in P_phone (lidar_x, lidar_y; mm).
param_notes.flash_x: Flash centre in P_phone (flash_x, flash_y; mm).
param_notes.phone_W: Phone outline (phone_W x phone_L x phone_t, mm) from Apple's dimensional drawing via iMuninn's phone data.
param_notes.outline_x: Centre of the phone outline in P_phone (mm). P_phone is the display-area centre (iMuninn device frame); 0 for the iPhone 17 Pro, at most 0.005 for the phones in the editor.
param_notes.lens_x: Main camera lens window centre in P_phone (lens_x, lens_y; mm), from iMuninn's phone data.
param_notes.bump_h: Height of the rear camera cover glass above the back glass (mm): camera plateau + lens glass. 4.43 for the iPhone 17 Pro (iMuninn, from Apple's drawing; confirmed by measurement 2026-11-27). Was 1.88, the glass above the plateau only.
param_notes.magsafe_x: MagSafe circle centre in P_phone (magsafe_x, magsafe_y; mm), from iMuninn's phone data. The holder (S_mount) sits on it because the phone locks on by MagSafe.
param_notes.corner_r: Corner radius of the phone body outline seen from the back (mm). Apple's drawings do not dimension it; 0.15 x the short side is iMuninn's estimate (its glb uses the same). Only the look and the phone's volume depend on it.

connector_b.desc: reBot gripper connector part B (2-M7-STATOR.step), in F_robot: a cup over part A, 3 radial M3 screws into A. Without the 4 tool-side holes.

difference.name: cup_centre
difference.desc: Centre opening in the cup floor (D26.2 in the official part; the printed tool has it as a pocket).

mjcf.desc: The reBot URDF/MJCF already has the gripper connector as link6, and a simulation mounts the tool on its tool face. So the MJCF is written relative to F_mount and leaves the adapter parts out.
